title: Implement environmental sensing characteristic mappings (K.3.1)
description:
Add to gatt_ipso.c static table, environmental sensing characteristics:

- Temperature 0x2A6E -> 3303/5700, Cel
- Humidity 0x2A6F -> 3304/5700, %RH
- Pressure 0x2A6D -> 3315/5700, Pa
- True Wind Speed 0x2A70 -> 26253/5700, m/s
- True Wind Direction 0x2A71 -> 26253/5701, deg
- Apparent Wind Speed 0x2A72 -> 26253/5702, m/s
- Apparent Wind Direction 0x2A73 -> 26253/5703, deg
- Gust Factor 0x2A74 -> 26253/5704, 1
- Pollen Concentration 0x2A75 -> 3325/5700, /m3
- UV Index 0x2A76 -> 26254/5700, 1
- Irradiance 0x2A77 -> 3301/5700, W/m2
- Rainfall 0x2A78 -> 26255/5700, mm
- Magnetic Declination 0x2A2C -> 26256/5700, deg
- Magnetic Flux 2D 0x2AA0 -> 3314/5702, T
- Magnetic Flux 3D 0x2AA1 -> 3314/5702, T
- Elevation 0x2A6C -> 3338/5700, m
- Dew Point 0x2A7B -> 3303/5701, Cel
- Heat Index 0x2A7A -> 3303/5702, Cel
- Wind Chill 0x2A79 -> 3303/5703, Cel

~19 entries. Reference: spec/appendix-gatt-ipso.md K.3.1
